title: GHSL AI-agent index lists mutable-ref TOCTOU in MongoDB BSON release workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: The release workflow does not pin maintainer authorization to a commit, then checks out and executes code from a mutable pull-request ref with repository write-token access.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index includes this advisory in its AI-discovered list. The item advisory credits only the human researcher and provides no agent-specific role; attribution is index-level only.
classification_note: The primary advisory documents the race and fix; no exploitation in the wild is claimed.
remediation_note: Fixed in PR #929 on 2026-09-03. A maintainer authorization is required to trigger the workflow.

impacts.conditions: External pull-request author can update the ref after maintainer review; code runs with the listed write permissions.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
